Gigan, a cyborg space kaiju that first appeared in 1972, battling Godzilla. Gigan is a cruel and merciless kaiju, sporting several advanced cybernetic enhancements designed to brutally maim other kaijus and level Earth. Despite all of this, Gigan is actually quite a coward and is derived from a very cute kaiju bird.
